common.eligibility_vs_ranking: Threshold/path membership is evaluated first. Ranking changes never change proxyHigh, tier or market pattern.
common.claim: Confirmed high profile proxy means only the observed/context proxy passed a published hypothesis; no measured visits, spending, borrowing, sales, approvals or investment recommendation.
common.tier: Relative profile signal strength/concentration, not probability, confidence or independent evidence count.
common.coverage: Fraction of required fields present, plus separate vintage/grain/reconciliation/scope flags; never call this confidence probability.
common.measured_demand_state: unknown until separately defined observed operational evidence is connected; unknown measured demand does not erase a known proxy screen.
common.quantile: PERCENTILE.INC over known finite non-negative values, including valid zeros; never missing-as-zero. Positive-presence gate is separate from cohort construction.

new_profile_guard.status: editable computational guard, not validated customer minimum; if too small, show raw context and review without declaring low Demand

common.cohort_filter: Map/province filters never recompute cutoffs. User cohort change creates a new criteria/cohort version.
common.unknown: Strong Kleene AND/OR; known qualifying path can confirm proxy high despite other missing paths. Missing may not promote the tier.
common.possible_tier: Show whether missing paths could strengthen an already-confirmed tier; keep confirmed tier and possible tiers distinct.
common.locale_insight: Notes/prior only. No eligibility/risk/behavior metric; no locale aggregation without explicit locale-to-boundary crosswalk.
common.geography: Direct reporting UUID joins only. Extents/centroids are not polygons or verified service catchments. No administrative-name/subdistrict-code substitution for LAO membership.
common.boundary_review: 7,954 source reporting units form the pinned universe; source membership is not independent statutory-boundary or physical-access verification.

benchmark.zero_cutoff_policy: literal_gte: an observed zero passes when percentile cutoff equals zero; do not silently add a positive-only gate
benchmark.chart_percentile_method: midrank; for sorted n>1 use 100*(lower_bound + 0.5*(tie_count-1))/(n-1); singleton=50
benchmark.thresholds: pinned P95/P99 from release when supplied; other thresholds PERCENTILE.INC over valid values; validate pinned thresholds against release cohort

tier_screen.qualifyingTier: minimum_positive_confirmed_building_or_activity_tier; enabled extra metric with confirmed pass qualifies at Tier 3
tier_screen.tierEligible: qualifyingTier is not null AND qualifyingTier <= maxDemandTier
tier_screen.application: applies only to confirmed high-demand locations; demandMode=all keeps confirmed low-demand selected patterns without applying the tier gate; unknown demand remains excluded
tier_screen.classification_unchanged: DemandHigh and 8 patterns still follow original high/low thresholds, independently from the maxTier gate and weights

supply.unknown_assumption: U covers countable, in-boundary operating sites whose only uncertainty is own vs competitor brand; enumerate B+k and C+U-k for integer k in [0,U]. Other uncertainties require production review.

map_score.note: Existing max-percentile map score is retained and must be labelled Demand signal. Weighted rankScore is a separate field; do not relabel the existing heat scale as rankScore.

passingSignalCount.role: legacy_order_only; weighted mode does not use this as a tie-breaker

legacy_ranking_order: source_rank_asc; production additionally place_id_asc for deterministic ties

weighted_ranking.formula: (wDemand * demandScore + wOwnGap * ownGap + wCompetitorGap * competitorGap) / sum(rankingWeights)
weighted_ranking.demand_group_score: sum(metricWeight * metricPercentile) / sum(active positive metricWeights) within each enabled group
weighted_ranking.demand_score: sum(groupWeight * groupScore) / sum(positive demandGroupWeights over enabled groups)
weighted_ranking.disabled_group_weights: ignored; extra default50 takes effect only when extraMetrics is nonempty
weighted_ranking.zero_metric_weight: excludes metric from ranking only; threshold hits and tier screening still use enabled metric

gaps.meaning: fewer observed branches gives a higher gap score; not a sales forecast or proof of feasibility

weighted_ranking.missing: retain full configured weight; missing metric percentile contributes lower=0, upper=100. Never renormalize weights over observed values only.
weighted_ranking.unknown_supply: if B/C/U is not a non-negative integer, both gap components use [0,100]; otherwise enumerate every integer k=0..U with B+k and C+U-k, and calculate weighted combined supply minimum/maximum across these same allocations
weighted_ranking.bounds: rankScore combines demand lower with joint supply lower; rankUpper combines demand upper with joint supply upper; never combine independent marginal supply extrema
weighted_ranking.stars: explanatory pattern labels only; not a primary weighted ranking term

weight_field_keys.metricWeights: all ready IDs from METRICS; future connected metrics require versioned update

return_fields.rankScore: conservative weighted lower bound on 0..100 scale
return_fields.rankUpper: weighted upper bound, shown as uncertainty
return_fields.rankCoverage: 0..1 weighted share from known demand observations and fully resolved supply (U=0); it is evidence coverage, not confidence probability
return_fields.qualifyingTier: best confirmed enabled-group tier, or null
return_fields.tierEligible: confirmed tier fits maxDemandTier; false for low demand where tier is not applicable

migration.missing_fields: fill defaults; preserve saved values, criteria version, events, POIs and shortlisted locations
migration.storage_cross_tab: normalize incoming criteria the same way; ignore malformed JSON

profiles.highway_context: Urban/built-area signals cannot rule out a through-traffic highway opportunity. Low/unknown urban proxy remains a corridor-review candidate if real vehicle volume, direction, access, frontage and competing-service evidence is supplied. No new highway cutoffs are invented.

refinement_option.change: Require value>0 in addition to >=cutoff for enabled threshold signals. If cohort too small/no variation, report uninformative benchmark; do not alter accepted baseline silently.
refinement_option.migration: Explicit criteria version/event and baseline-versus-refined membership diff required.
refinement_option.numeric_cutoffs: Same user P99/P95 and 5/3/1 hit defaults, 3/3 supply defaults; all extras remain off.

profiles.correlation: GFA count/person/area and factory count/area/workers/area, hotel rooms/area are related representations. Six hits do not represent six independent demand sources. Hotel rooms are capacity inventory, not occupancy/visitors.

This choice is a transparent study definition, not an operator or observed outcome threshold; confirm against refreshed same-UUID per-brand/format distribution and field findings.
default_supply.unmapped: Mapping gaps do not prove absence. Unknown location/function/product is not the original fuel brand-only U.

ranking.path_strength: For each confirmed path at the best confirmed tier, use the minimum percentile among its required metrics; take the maximum among those equally-tiered paths. This describes the strongest confirmed weakest-link path, not a probability.
ranking.scope: All default profiles use the same fixed national7954UUID universe, known-valid per metric. Province, brand and map filters never change this benchmark. Optional grain diagnostics do not replace the user-selected national default.
ranking.coverage_display: Coverage and review flags remain separate visible columns, not a hidden rank penalty.
ranking.no_supply_bonus: Sparse listed supply is a field question, not verified unmet demand. No default numeric supply/capacity weights.
ranking.optional_weighted: Only an explicit user-selected/versioned hypothesis; equal or other weights are not empirically calibrated. Retain interval bounds for unknowns.

profiles.all_yolk_view: Demand-proxy-only independent from expansion-pattern filter; all8patterns retained and editable

optional_context.total_modeled_gfa: Built-form context only; not residential GFA, occupied premises, households or daytime employment. Off in default demand paths.
optional_context.office_catalog: Show verified published catalog positives/zeros only; zero is not no workplaces. No national percentile-demand gate.
optional_context.hotel_rooms: Tourism-capacity context shown separately/off in default screen. Add observed seasonal occupancy/visitor movement before a visitor-demand route.
optional_context.schools: Future verified-year/code/attendance/public-access research; no guessed current student metrics.
optional_context.estimated_store_traffic: Exclude source type-based estimates from observed demand/footfall/capacity.

profiles.format_policy: One Grocery adapter with separate format profiles, not separate branded files. Convenience default; mini-supermarket/supermarket/hypermarket/wholesale views may inspect same context but cannot inherit validated convenience thresholds or direct-peer counts.

peer_scope.default: source C_STORE seven-eleven own; other C_STORE candidate providers. Verified convenience versus mini-supermarket mapping is required for direct-format peer labels.
peer_scope.strict_direct_peer: Include only verified selected format, same customer mission/channel and listed service location; exclude supermarkets/hypermarkets/wholesale/pharmacy from convenience direct peers.
peer_scope.potential_peers: Unverified C_STORE formats retained as potential nearby providers, not silently included as confirmed same-format rivals.

field_questions: Where are occupied residences and public entrances inside the large area?
Do factory shifts exit past accessible retail frontage?
Are other C_STORE points convenience or mini-supermarket formats?
What hours, basket mission, delivery reach, rents and own-store cannibalisation occur?

formulaContract.rawJoin: Raw fields selected at source period and exact reporting UUID before evaluation
formulaContract.division: Positive denominator required; unavailable/suppressed/notapplicable is not0

calibration_protocol.default_cutoffs: P50/P75/P90 chosen as transparent moderate/upper-tail research screens, not operator cutoffs. Tune by field-study yield and independent outcomes.
calibration_protocol.field_study: Stratify all3tiers plus below-screen and unknown controls within geography/format/product; sample by practical field capacity. Record occupied destinations, access, opening/function/format and missing-source causes. Do not evaluate only selected winners.
calibration_protocol.later_outcomes: Grocery: comparable format/maturity/channel sales/visits; Fuel: verified traffic/access and station outcomes; Nonbank: aggregate product-specific service inquiries/access journeys. Individual credit records/eligibility not required.
calibration_protocol.evaluation: Predefine useful field-visit finding, conversion from area to viable corridor/site, precision/recall and coverage; evaluate out of period and in held-out geography, report uncertainty/sample bias.
calibration_protocol.sensitivity: Cutoffs +/-5 percentile points, cohort and denominator choices, zeros, product/formatscope, mappingcoverage, source-vintage changes; publish membershipdiff.
calibration_protocol.versioning: Criteria, cohort, metrics/source snapshot and adapter revisions pinned atomically. Changes do not rewrite previously accepted teamcriteria or logs.
